task: round 20 scan: insertion direction after cap 6 = +0.002 public; next rungs and pre-registered 28 Sep / 29 Sep order by probe-46 outcome
summary: Probe 45 (K2 + insertion cap 6) = 0.956, while the in-sample exp60 lab had said -0.00057. This scan widens that lab sweep to 29 arms (scratchpad/r20ins, tools/ untouched, cap-4 parity exact). The lab dip at cap 6 is 4 FP events. From cap 8 on, the lab rises steadily up to cap 24 + frame cap 2: +0.0019 vs cap 6 and +0.0013 vs K2 pooled, with 44b6 flat and 6bba +0.002. So from cap 12 upward the lab and the public read now agree in sign (lab in-sample, small n). Frame cap 3 is worse than 2; no frame cap costs -0.00055 of adjusted edge J (519 steals). Steal off is -0.002, and a clip-size-scaled cap is dominated by a plain cap. Runtime cost is ~0 by construction: DaughterNet scores every candidate triple before cap, threshold or frame cap are applied, and probe 45's hidden latency (7.49, 7.67] h is inside K2's noise. A Monte Carlo conditioned on K2 0.954 -> cap6 0.956 is a model estimate driven by one read. It gives P(display >= 0.957) of 0.40 for cap 8, 0.60 for cap 12 + fc2 (exp78b) and 0.645 for cap 24 + fc2. P(<= 0.955) is ~0.27-0.29 for every thr-0.4 rung with frame cap <= 2, and 0.34-0.41 for thr 0.3/0.2 rungs. Recommendation: in W1, geometrically bracket insertion volume with exp78b (cap 12 fc2, ~2x the cap 4->6 volume step) and a NEW exp80a (K2 + cap 24 + fc2, ~3.8x). Demote cap 8 to a W2 fallback and drop exp76e (E ~+7e-5). The probe-46 rows below switch to thr-0.3 stacks only if 46 >= 0.957. Nothing here is a new research mechanism: all rungs are existing-knob public rungs under the user's aggressive-mode lift (11:14/11:16Z), so as R8 items the honest answer is none.
